name: @platform/dwi-host
description: Local, consent-based project intelligence with project-aware Prompt Optimizer and optional provider refinement.

scripts.package:vsix: pnpm build:deps && pnpm build && node scripts/package-vsix.mjs
scripts.build:deps: pnpm --filter @platform/domain-prompt-optimizer build && pnpm --filter @platform/domain-workspace build && pnpm --filter @platform/dwi-core build && pnpm --filter @platform/dwi-webview build

untrustedWorkspaces.description: DWI only reads bounded manifest/config evidence after its own explicit project consent and does not execute workspace code.
